name: Mohamad Hasan
_note: M2 full-cabinet completion: Minister of Foreign Affairs since the 12 Dec 2023 reshuffle. metrics.justification: No charge or conviction of record. A 2018-2019 anti-corruption investigation was closed with no further action and no charge filed; a 2019 civil-forfeiture action concerned UMNO party accounts, not him personally. A partisan blog's "charges prepared" claim is single-source, uncorroborated by any primary document or named outlet, and is not recorded.

metrics.justification: Sustained consular crisis response to Malaysians trapped in Myanmar/Thailand job-scam syndicates: by Feb 2025, 114 had been repatriated from Myanmar and 157 from Thailand with documented consular procedures, with further batches through Dec 2025. Measurable, documented repatriations, credit shared with the wider government (anchor 3).

metrics.justification: As 2025 ASEAN chair, delivered the accession of Timor-Leste as the bloc's 11th member (instrument deposited 25 Oct 2025; admitted at the 47th Summit, 26 Oct 2025), the first enlargement since 1999 and a stated chairmanship priority; economic deliverables such as the upgraded ATIGA were advanced but not all ratified (anchor 3).

citation.title: Forging a New Era: Timor-Leste Admitted into ASEAN

metrics.justification: Malaysia's ASEAN-chair year widened and convened the institution: Timor-Leste's admission and the first ASEAN-GCC and ASEAN-GCC-China summits. Documented institution-building, with credit shared across the government (anchor 3).
